brief:
Israeli strikes killed five people in Gaza on Friday, according to authorities in the Strip, Middle East Eye reported. The deaths occurred as military operations continued despite mounting international pressure to advance negotiations on a ceasefire and peace settlement.

The civil defence agency in Gaza confirmed the casualties from the strikes. The killings represent the latest in a series of attacks that have persisted even as diplomatic efforts have intensified calls for a halt to hostilities and resumption of peace talks aimed at ending the conflict.
